data.name: Tray_Mode_Row
data.comment: Show menu entry for the inline row of every limit at once. macOS only; the entry is absent where the indicator must be square.

data.name: Tray_Tooltip_NeedsCredential
data.value: ClaudeStatus — no Claude credential. Click to open Config.

data.name: Tray_Tooltip_Unreachable
data.value: ClaudeStatus — cannot reach the usage endpoint

data.name: Details_Status_Cooldown
data.value: Refreshed recently — try again in a moment.

data.name: Details_Status_NoCredential
data.value: No Claude credential found. Open Config to set one up.

data.name: Details_Status_Unauthorized
data.value: The credential was rejected. Open Claude Code to refresh your login.

data.name: Details_Status_RateLimited
data.value: Rate limited by the endpoint. Retrying automatically.

data.name: Details_Status_Unreachable
data.value: Could not reach the usage endpoint. Retrying automatically.

data.name: Details_Stale
data.value: Showing the last known values, {0} old.

data.name: Config_Source_ClaudeCode_Help
data.value: Reads the login Claude Code already has. Nothing is stored by ClaudeStatus. Data goes stale about an hour after Claude Code last refreshed.

data.name: Config_Source_Manual_Help
data.value: For machines without Claude Code. The token is stored encrypted.

data.name: Config_EncryptionNotice
data.value: Your credential is encrypted with an OS-bound key ({0}). It cannot be copied to another machine or user account.

data.name: Config_WeakStoreWarning
data.value: No system keyring was found, so your token is protected by an encrypted file readable only by your user account. Another program running as you could still read it. Installing a keyring (gnome-keyring or KWallet) is safer.

data.name: Config_TrayWarning_NoSession
data.value: No desktop session was detected, so the tray icon will not appear.

data.name: Config_TrayWarning_Unlikely
data.value: This desktop may not show tray icons. On GNOME, install the AppIndicator extension.

data.name: Config_Threshold_Help
data.value: The tray icon turns red once the metric on show reaches this.

data.name: Config_Interval_Help
data.value: 60 seconds is the floor. The endpoint rate limits aggressively and can stay throttled for a whole session.

data.name: Config_Language_Help
data.value: To add a language, copy a file in {0} and translate its values. It appears here after a restart.

data.name: Info_Tagline
data.value: Claude subscription usage, in your system tray.

data.name: Info_UnofficialNotice
data.value: Usage numbers come from an undocumented Anthropic endpoint — the same one Claude Code's /usage command uses. It is not a published API and may change or stop working without notice. Numbers can differ slightly from those shown in claude.ai Settings. This project is not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic.

data.name: Info_License
data.value: MIT licence. Built with Avalonia UI.

data.name: Credential_None
data.value: Looks like a valid access token.

data.name: Credential_WrongPrefix
data.value: That does not look like a Claude access token. It should start with "sk-ant-oat".

data.name: Credential_TooShort
data.value: That token looks too short to be complete.

data.name: Credential_IllegalCharacters
data.value: That contains characters a token does not. Check for stray spaces or line breaks.

data.name: Credential_RefreshToken
data.value: That is a refresh token ("sk-ant-ort"). ClaudeStatus needs the access token ("sk-ant-oat").

data.name: Credential_Unknown
data.value: That token could not be validated.

data.name: CredentialTest_SuccessNoWindow
data.value: Works, though the endpoint reported no session window.

data.name: CredentialTest_NoCredential
data.value: No credential found. Sign in with Claude Code, or paste a token above.

data.name: CredentialTest_Rejected
data.value: The credential was rejected. If you are using the Claude Code login, open Claude Code to refresh it.

data.name: CredentialTest_RateLimited
data.value: Rate limited, so the credential could not be checked. Try again in a few minutes.

data.name: CredentialTest_ServerError
data.value: The endpoint returned a server error. This is not a problem with your credential.

data.name: CredentialTest_Unreachable
data.value: Could not reach the endpoint. Check your network connection.

data.name: CredentialTest_Unreadable
data.value: The endpoint answered with something unreadable. It may have changed.

data.name: Store_LinuxEncryptedFile
data.value: Encrypted key file (no system keyring available)

data.name: Autostart_Error_PathUnknown
data.value: The application path could not be determined, so autostart cannot be set up.

data.name: Autostart_Error_Write
data.value: The autostart entry could not be written.

data.name: Autostart_Error_Remove
data.value: The autostart entry could not be removed.

data.name: Autostart_Error_RunKey
data.value: The Windows Run key could not be opened.

data.name: Tray_Row_Fable
data.comment: Menu bar row label for the weekly Fable limit. Kept to one letter: the row sits in the macOS menu bar beside the clock.

data.name: Report_NoReading
data.value: No reading yet. The first poll has not completed.

data.name: Report_StaleWarning
data.value: These are the last known values. A refresh has not succeeded since.

data.name: Report_Spend_NotReported
data.value: The endpoint reported nothing about spending.

data.name: Report_Spend_Off
data.value: Off. You are not being charged beyond your plan.

data.name: Report_Credits_NotReported
data.value: The endpoint reported nothing about credits.

data.name: Report_Credits_NeverUsed
data.value: Not set up on this account.

data.name: Report_Credits_TurnedOff
data.value: Set up but currently switched off.

data.name: Report_Credits_LimitReached
data.value: The monthly credit limit has been reached.

data.name: Report_Disclaimer
data.value: These are the raw figures the endpoint returned, including its own labels. It is undocumented, so a field can change meaning or disappear without notice.

data.name: Config_Theme_Help
data.value: To add a theme, put a JSON file in {0} with name, primary, background, text and alert. It appears here after a restart.

data.name: Config_Font_Help
data.value: A font that is not installed falls back to the system default.

data.name: Config_Transparency_Help
data.value: 0 % is a solid panel; 100 % leaves only the text floating over the desktop. Affects the small popup only, never its text. Some Linux desktops do not allow transparency, in which case this has no effect.

data.name: Details_Empty_Waiting_Body
data.value: The first request is on its way. This normally takes a second or two.

data.name: Details_Empty_NoCredential_Body
data.value: ClaudeStatus reads the login Claude Code already has. Sign in there, or add a token on the Account tab in Config.

data.name: Details_Empty_Unauthorized_Body
data.value: Anthropic turned the credential down. Open Claude Code and sign in again, or replace the token on the Account tab in Config.

data.name: Details_Empty_RateLimited_Body
data.value: The endpoint is rate limiting requests. ClaudeStatus is backing off and will try again on its own.

data.name: Details_Empty_Unreachable_Body
data.value: The usage endpoint did not answer. Check your connection — ClaudeStatus keeps retrying in the background.

data.name: Update_Ready
data.value: Version {0} is ready. It installs the next time ClaudeStatus starts.

data.name: Config_AutomaticUpdates_Help
data.value: Asks GitHub for new releases every few hours and downloads them in the background. An update installs the next time ClaudeStatus starts, never while you are using it. Turning this off stops the request being made at all.

data.name: Config_Indicator_Widget_Help
data.value: A small card in the taskbar, beside the clock, showing your limits at once. It relies on taskbar internals Microsoft does not document; if it cannot attach, the tray icon is used instead.

data.name: Config_Indicator_Icon_Help
data.value: One metric as a number in the notification area. Switch the metric from the icon's menu.

data.name: Config_Widget_ShowFable
data.value: Show the Fable limit in the widget

data.name: Config_Widget_ShowFable_Help
data.value: Off by default: most plans reach the session or weekly limit long before the Fable one, and the widget is narrower without it. The popup always shows all three.

data.name: Config_Row_ShowFable
data.value: Show the Fable limit in the menu bar
data.comment: Shown only where the indicator can be wider than it is tall (macOS). The Windows widget has its own wording in Config_Widget_ShowFable.

data.name: Config_Row_ShowFable_Help
data.value: Off by default: most plans reach the session or weekly limit long before the Fable one, and the menu bar item is shorter without it. The popup always shows all three.
data.comment: Shown only where the indicator can be wider than it is tall (macOS). The Windows widget has its own wording in Config_Widget_ShowFable.

data.name: Config_Widget_FollowSystem_Help
data.value: No card: a transparent background and the same text colour as the clock. Off, the widget is drawn in your theme's colours.

data.name: Velocity_Alert
data.value: Usage is climbing fast: at this pace the {0} limit runs out in about {1}, well before it resets in {2}.

data.name: Config_VelocityAlerts
data.value: Warn when usage is climbing too fast

data.name: Config_VelocityAlerts_Help
data.value: Shows a warning when the current pace would use up a window before it resets, so a runaway task does not surprise you. The warning also stays in the details view while it holds.
